note: AM-23's QAT epoch rules (lane L-AM23Q): E6-E2, E6-R1 and E6-R2, which run AM-4a item 1's recipe and AM-4a item 2's selection as AM-21 amends it. Read by scripts/select_qat_epoch.py and scripts/qat_epoch_eval.py finalize through src/quant/qat_select.py (RULES_FILES), which refuses a disagreement.
